properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a Claude Code session on flo2.io (reflow2 0.81.1) recorded four cross-design relations as prose and wrote "reflow2 draws no edges between designs" into flo2's design, because the brainstorm and capture-intent skills, the two that fire when a relation is drawn, never name `other_design`; the `incoming` flag met the same fate on 2026-09-19
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-10, at Anthony's request, reviewing a note a StoryFlow session wrote into flo2's design.

① OBSERVED. On 2026-10-10 at 19:08 UTC a Claude Code session working StoryFlow's design (0dcdeca97f8810ce, hosted on flo2.io, engine 0.81.1) wrote in FLO2's design (through the chat connector) fact:storyflow-mirrors-flo2s-auth-shape-2026-10-10 and chg:storyflow-adopted-flo2s-auth-shape-2026-10-10, whose rationale reads verbatim: "reflow2 draws no edges across designs, so a requirement on StoryFlow citing flo2 node ids is invisible from flo2's side." Its four StoryFlow requirements (written 19:03 through api.flo2.io) cite flo2 nodes by id in their text; StoryFlow's design holds no xref into flo2 (searched). EXPECTED: four typed links (review_relations with other_design, EVOLVES_INTO or DEPENDS_ON) drawn in StoryFlow's design, which 0.81.0 has served since 2026-10-07 and which this hub session drew nine of earlier the same day. NOT AFFECTED: the engine, which served the field in review_relations' schema to that very session (it called review_relations on StoryFlow at 18:44 and 18:52, within the design).

② PRECEDENT, searched in reflow2, flo2 and StoryFlow. reflow2: fact:the-direction-flag-on-a-relation-exists-and-no-skill-names-it-so-two-edges-landed-reversed (2026-09-19): "the field existed, the tool served it, and its absence was inferred from a reply and from a skill that did not mention it". Its fix (chg:a-drawn-relation-is-read-back-as-a-sentence) named `incoming` in the brainstorm skill: the instance, not the class. Also reflow2's own dec:idea-a-person-learns-what-to-do-next-once-they-have-a-design carries a no_relation_note from 2026-09-24, "the flo2 twin lives in another design, so it is named in the text; no cross-design edge is drawn", true then, a stale premise now. flo2 and StoryFlow: no prior statement of the claim.

③ CANDIDATES, from the design.
(A) Intent/instruction: the capture-time skills do not name `other_design`. (B) Contract/door: flo2's connector `describe` for review_relations (short form) lists `links` as "The relations you judged to be real" and no per-link field, so a chat never sees `other_design` unless it asks for `full`. (C) Staleness: the session read prose carrying the old premise. (D) Outside the suspected component: the client had a stale tool list (pre-0.81.0 schema). (E) The observation is wrong: the links were drawn and the finding merely mirrors them.

④/⑤ MEASUREMENTS. (A) grep of the served texts fetched today: brainstorm, no `other_design`; capture-intent, none; link-ideas, one sentence; hub, one paragraph under "Honest limits". The call log shows the session fetched exactly one skill on StoryFlow: brainstorm (15:23). HOLDS. (B) describe short vs full on flo2's connector: short shows no per-link fields; full does. The session described only record_finding and add_change_event on flo2, never review_relations. HOLDS as contributing: it removes the one place a chat would have met the field without a skill. (C) search of flo2 and StoryFlow for the claim: no prior occurrence; the flo2 nodes the session read (auth nodes, listed in the log) say nothing about edges. REFUTED. (D) the session called review_relations and create_edges on StoryFlow through api.flo2.io on 0.81.1, so it held the current schema. REFUTED. (E) StoryFlow holds no xref node into flo2. REFUTED.

⑥ CLASS. A parameter added to review_relations' per-link shape (`incoming` on 09-19, `other_design` on 10-07) is named by the skills that instruct linking only by hand, and nothing checks it. The 09-19 fix named one parameter in one skill; the next parameter met the same silence. The cause is a contract maintained by hand with nothing checking it, which is the shape the root-cause skill itself predicts.

⑦ TO PIN (not yet done; the fix is a reflow2 PR): a lint over the served skills that fails when any field of RelationLinkReq (`incoming`, `other_design`, `other_name`) is absent from brainstorm, capture-intent and link-ideas, observed failing on today's texts first. ⑧ FIX: name `other_design` in brainstorm's step 4 and capture-intent's relation step, in one sentence each, beside `incoming`; keep this finding on those steps so it is served there. ⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether flo2's short describe should list array-item fields (flo2's call); whether the 09-24 stale note in reflow2 was read by anyone since. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
